name: v0.2.1
body:
- Let Markdown's paragraphs be selected and copied, not just its code
- Close a dialog when the backdrop outside it is pressed
- Comment on a range of lines, and show more of a file around its diff
- Copy inline code without the thin spaces that pad it
- Keep a typed-in dialog open when the backdrop is pressed
- Call GitLab's bots by their display names
- Fetch GitLab's avatars and attachments through its API
- Render Markdown's comments, images and table cells as the forges do
- Show GitLab's system notes as plain text
- Show where each pull request's review stands in lists
- Show emoji shortcodes as their emoji
- Draw HTML tables as tables
- Fold `<details>` sections under their summaries

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/IAmJSD/visualhub/compare/v0.2.0...v0.2.1
